title: UKF SLAM-Enhanced Perception and Navigation for Effective Area Coverage in Autonomous Driving
authors: H. Mailka; M. Abouzahir; M. Ramzi; A. E. Ouardi; S. R. Flórez
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
